querySql:
select 
                                      id,
                                      industry_code,
                                      industry_name,
                                      industry_level,
                                      con_date,
                                      index_code,
                                      con_or_roll,
                                      con_np_roll,
                                      con_eps_roll,
                                      con_na_roll,
                                      con_pb_roll,
                                      con_ps_roll,
                                      con_pe_roll,
                                      con_peg_roll,
                                      con_roe_roll,
                                      con_npcgrate_2y_roll,
                                      con_or_yoy_roll,
                                      con_np_yoy_roll,
                                      entrytime,
                                      updatetime,
                                      tmstamp,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'zyyx_con_forecast_roll_citic.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.con_forecast_roll_citic WHERE con_date BETWEEN '${beg_date}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${beg_date}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
